slides.heading: Three Number Sort
slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Medium · Sorting
slides.narration: Let's solve Three Number Sort, a medium sorting problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: Sort an array in place according to a 3-value `order` (Dutch national flag).
slides.narration: Here's the problem. Sort an array in place according to a 3-value order (Dutch national flag).

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: Dutch national flag: three regions grown by three pointers in one pass.
slides.narration: Dutch national flag: three regions grown by three pointers in one pass.

slides.heading: Brute force vs optimal
bullets: Counting pass + rewrite → O(n), two passes
Dutch national flag → O(n), one pass, O(1) space
slides.narration: Sorting is n log n. Counting each value and rewriting is linear but two passes. The Dutch national flag algorithm does it in one pass with three pointers.

slides.heading: Approach
slides.narration: Step by step. First, first, second and third pointers. Second, swap firsts to the front. Third, leave seconds. Fourth, swap thirds to the back.

slides.heading: Worked example
slides.caption: 1: second → leave it
slides.narration: Mid saw 1, the second value, so we leave it.

slides.heading: Worked example
slides.caption: 0: first → swap to lo
slides.narration: Mid saw 0, the first value, so we swap to lo.

slides.heading: Worked example
slides.caption: -1: third → swap to hi
slides.narration: Mid saw -1, the third value, so we swap to hi.

slides.heading: Worked example
slides.caption: 1: second → leave it
slides.narration: Mid saw 1, the second value, so we leave it.

slides.heading: Worked example
slides.caption: 1: second → leave it
slides.narration: Mid saw 1, the second value, so we leave it.

slides.heading: Worked example
slides.caption: 0: first → swap to lo
slides.narration: Mid saw 0, the first value, so we swap to lo.

slides.heading: Java solution
slides.narration: Lo, mid and hi start at the ends. While mid is at most hi, first-order values swap to lo and both advance, second-order values just advance mid, and third-order values swap with hi, which moves down.

slides.heading: Complexity
slides.narration: Time is O of n. Space is constant.

slides.heading: Edge cases & pitfalls
bullets: Don't advance mid after swapping with hi
slides.narration: After swapping with hi, don't advance mid: the swapped-in value hasn't been examined.
